_note: MAX6675 K-type thermocouple-to-digital converter module (Maxim). SPI read-only interface. 5-pin breakout: VCC, GND, SCK, CS (chip select active low), SO (serial data out / MISO). 12-bit resolution, 0-1024C range in 0.25C steps. Cold-junction compensation built in. Read-only — no registers to write, just clock out 16 bits (D15..D0, temperature in bits 14..3).
